name: GpuEdgeCost
definition: A WebGPU compute shader that evaluates the L2 field-error cost for one dense slot per thread, mirroring the CPU `computeEdgeCost` logic.
summary: GpuEdgeCost is a WebGPU compute shader that evaluates L2 field-error costs for merging 3D Gaussians, using WGSL to handle large datasets in batches and overcome GPU memory binding limits.
